title: BANZA Operator Capability Descriptor
description: Describes the declared capabilities of a BANZA operator and the conformance profile each implies.

supports_wallets.description: Wallet creation, balance query, and ledger. Required at the level given by certification_level (see the profile registry).

supports_qr.description: QR code generation (POST /qr), scanning (decode BANZA-SBX: or BANZA: payload), and pay (POST /qr/:id/pay). Required at the level given by certification_level (see the profile registry).

supports_settlement.description: Settlement batch creation (POST /settlements/run), status query, and fee model. Required at the level given by certification_level (see the profile registry).

supports_payment_requests.description: Payment request creation, retrieval, and payment. Required at the level given by certification_level (see the profile registry).

supports_payment_intents.description: PaymentIntent (ADR-014) — the canonical payment-initiation primitive that Payment Links/QR/Payment Requests realize. Underpins Collections. Optional; Level 2.

supports_collections.description: Payment Collections (ADR-018): Collection + CollectionShare aggregates, CollectionRule strategies, state machines, collection.* events, per-share settlement via PaymentIntent -> Transfer -> Ledger. Requires supports_payment_intents. Optional; Level 2.

supports_events.description: Event emission via GET /events/history (SSE or polling). Required at the level given by certification_level (see the profile registry).

supports_traces.description: Financial traceability via GET /traces and GET /traces/:id. Required at the level given by certification_level (see the profile registry).

supports_webhooks.description: Webhook delivery with signed event envelopes. Optional; recommended for production operators.

supports_federation.description: Cross-operator federation. Requires valid manifest, capability negotiation, and Level 2 trace support. Required at the level given by certification_level (see the profile registry).

CertificationLevelImplications.description: The minimum capabilities required at each certification level.

_authority: contracts/production/conformance-profiles.production.json is the normative definition of which profile requires which capability. The certification_level annotations here MUST agree with it; where they differ, the registry governs. They carried a superseded mapping until this was corrected.
